_note: Background music (src/audio/music.gd). states: which track plays when (menu = title, lobby and after a defeat; explore = a quiet room; combat = a fight with enemies alive or a horde still coming; boss = a boss or mini-boss alive). track names a music entry of audio_library.json (one id or a list: the first that exists plays); volume_db trims it on top of its gain_db; ambience true lays the ambience track under it on the Ambience bus. worlds: the story worlds' own explore, combat and boss tracks and ambience bed (src/hero/story_sound.gd tells music.gd the world: krypta, frost, hell); a world track that does not exist yet falls back to states and ambience, so the files can come one by one (docs/KLANG-KONZEPT.de.md 3.8, docs/KLANG-EREIGNISSE.de.md). crossfade: seconds between two tracks; calm_hold: seconds a fight must be over before the music calms down again (no flip-flopping between waves). Change the choices in the Klangwerkstatt (debug menu) or here.
